name: io.github.JacobJandon/ainra
description: Verify an AI agent's identity offline: run the real AINRA verifier over a presentation bundle and get a verdict plus a named reason. Read-only tools need no credentials; write tools require explicit confirmation and a registrar you control.

environmentVariables.name: AINRA_TARGET
environmentVariables.description: A local registrar directory (e.g. genesis-out) or the base URL of an AINRA network you control. There is no hosted default and no fallback: if the target is unreachable the tools say so and stop.
